svg.title: Local working-set comparison for error ingestion
svg.desc: Pre-batch Docker working-set snapshots, median across three batches: tiny-sentry 27.50 MiB, Sentry errors-only 4637.53 MiB. Different resource allocations and product capabilities.

g.text: Pre-batch working set · median across 3 batches · linear scale from 0 to 5120 MiB
tiny-sentry: 1 CPU / 128 MiB cap. Sentry: unrestricted within the shared 12-CPU / ~8 GB Docker VM.
Snapshots are not load peaks. Both use warmed projects. Local ARM64 results, not Railway metrics.
Sentry provides more features in this mode. This is not a feature-equivalent capacity comparison.
